text:
Field name: acquirer
Description: Name of the acquiring bank or institution.
Data type: string
Sample values: gringotts, bank_of_springfield
Field name: country_code
Description: ISO country code of the acquirer.
Data type: string
Sample values: GB, US, NL, IT, FR

Field name: merchant_category_code
Description: List of merchant category codes; null means applies to all MCCs
Data type: list of integers or null
Sample values: [8062, 8011, 8021], None
Relationships: column: merchant_data.mcc, relationship: match if the mcc is in the list or the list is empty; column: payments.merchant, relationship: lookup mcc based on merchant name
Domain knowledge: MCC (Merchant Category Code) is a four-digit code assigned by card networks to categorize merchant business type, following ISO 18245 standard., MCC affects payment processing rates, risk assessment, fraud detection, and accounting., MCC is used to determine applicable interchange rates and fee schedules., A complete list of MCCs is available in merchant_category_codes.csv.
Field name: monthly_fraud_level
Description: Range of percentage = fraudulent transactions / total transactions in a month; null means applies to all levels
Data type: string (percentage range) or null
Sample values: 7.7%-8.3%, <3%, None
Relationships: columns: ['payments.has_fraudulent_dispute', 'payments.day_of_year'], relationship: calculate percentage and check if within defined range
Possible formulas: monthly_fraud_rate = sum(has_fraudulent_dispute == 'True') / count(*) over month by merchant
Domain knowledge: Fraud level is the ratio of fraudulent volume to total volume, measured monthly., Higher fraud rates increase processing costs and may trigger account review or penalties., Maintaining low fraud levels is essential to minimize fees and avoid penalties., Best practices include using AVS, CVV, 3D Secure, and risk engines to reduce fraud.
Field name: monthly_volume
Description: Range of total transaction amount in a month per merchant; null means applies to all volumes
Data type: string (euro range) or null
Sample values: 100k-1m, None
Relationships: columns: ['payments.eur_amount', 'day_of_year'], relationship: aggregate monthly total and check if within range
Possible formulas: monthly_volume = sum(eur_amount) over month by merchant
Domain knowledge: Monthly transaction volume per merchant determines eligibility for tiered pricing models., Higher volumes typically result in lower per-transaction fees due to economies of scale., No minimum volume is required, but larger volumes flatten the pricing curve for better rates.
Field name: is_credit
Description: Boolean: true if payment is by credit card; null means applies to all
Data type: boolean or null
Sample values: True, False, None
Relationships: column: payments.is_credit, relationship: convert both into boolean and match the value
Domain knowledge: Credit card transactions often incur higher interchange and processing fees than debit., Fee rules may specifically target credit transactions for higher rates.
Field name: intracountry
Description: 1.0 if issuing_country == acquirer_country, else 0.0; null means applies to all
Data type: float (1.0 or 0.0) or null
Sample values: 1.0, 0.0, None
Relationships: columns: ['payments.issuing_country', 'payments.acquirer_country'], relationship: compare to get the boolean value
Possible formulas: intracountry = 1.0 if issuing_country == acquirer_country else 0.0
Domain knowledge: Intracountry (domestic) transactions occur when issuing and acquiring countries are the same., Local acquiring reduces transaction friction, improves conversion, and lowers fees., Cross-border payments may incur additional fees, currency conversion, and compliance checks.
Field name: aci
Description: List of ACI codes; empty means applies to all
Data type: list of strings or empty list
Sample values: ['A', 'B', 'C'], []
Relationships: column: payments.aci, relationship: match if the aci is in the list or the list is empty
Domain knowledge: ACI (Authorization Characteristics Indicator) categorizes transaction authentication and flow., Different ACI codes reflect card presence, authentication method, and risk level., Choosing the right ACI can optimize fees and reduce transaction friction.
Field name: account_type
Description: List of account types; empty means applies to all
Data type: list of strings or empty list
Sample values: ['R', 'D', 'H'], []
Relationships: column: merchant_data.account_type, relationship: match if the account_type is in the list or the list is empty; column: merchant_data.merchant, relationship: lookup account_type based on merchant name; column: merchant_data.account_type, relationship: exact match against list values
Domain knowledge: Account type classifies merchants by business model (e.g., Retail, Digital, Hospitality, Franchise, SaaS, Other)., Account type impacts fee schedules, settlement times, and support services., See manual.md for account type definitions.
Field name: capture_delay
Description: Range of integers (e.g., '<3', '3-5') or string (e.g., 'manual'); null means applies to all
Data type: string (range or label) or null
Sample values: <3, 3-5, manual, None
Relationships: column: merchant_data.capture_delay, relationship: if range, check if capture_delay falls within range; if not, exact match
Domain knowledge: Capture delay is the time from authorization to settlement (e.g., '<3', '3-5', 'immediate', 'manual')., Faster capture (shorter delay) may increase fees but improves cash flow., Late settlement can cause transaction downgrades and higher costs.

Field name: mcc
Description: Merchant Category Code (MCC), a four-digit number assigned to a business by card networks.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 1520, 5812, 7997
Domain knowledge: MCC is used to categorize business type, affects risk, fraud, and fees. First two digits: category; last two: subcategory.
Field name: description
Description: Text description of the merchant category.
Data type: string
Sample values: General Contractors - Residential and Commercial, Eating Places and Restaurants, Membership Clubs (Sports, Recreation, Athletic), Country Clubs, and Private Golf Courses
Domain knowledge: Defined by MCC, describes merchant business type.

Field name: merchant
Description: Merchant name.
Data type: string
Sample values: Crossfit_Hanna, Belles_cookbook_store
Field name: capture_delay
Description: Capture delay for settlement, can be a label or a number.
Data type: string or integer
Sample values: manual, immediate, 1, 2, 7
Domain knowledge: Time from authorization to settlement. Faster capture (e.g. immediate) is more expensive.
Field name: acquirer
Description: List of acquirers for the merchant.
Data type: list of strings
Sample values: ['gringotts', 'medici'], ['bank_of_springfield']
Domain knowledge: Acquirer processes card payments. Local acquiring (same country as issuer) reduces fees.
Field name: merchant_category_code
Description: Merchant Category Code (MCC) for the merchant.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 7997, 5812, 5942
Domain knowledge: MCC categorizes business, affects risk, fraud, and fees.
Field name: account_type
Description: Account type for the merchant.
Data type: string
Sample values: F, H, R, D, S
Domain knowledge: Account type (R, D, H, F, S, O) is based on business model/industry and affects fee rules.

Field name: psp_reference
Description: Unique identifier for each payment transaction, used for tracking and reconciliation.
Data type: string
Sample values: 20034594130, 36926127356
Domain knowledge: Each payment is assigned a unique reference for traceability and dispute resolution.
Field name: merchant
Description: Name of the merchant processing the transaction; may be a brand or platform.
Data type: string
Sample values: Crossfit_Hanna, Belles_cookbook_store, Golfclub_Baron_Friso
Relationships: column: merchant_data.merchant, relationship: exact match against merchant names
Domain knowledge: Merchant names are used for reporting, analytics, and fee calculation., Merchant names may be mapped to merchant category codes (MCC) for risk and pricing.
Field name: card_scheme
Description: Card network or scheme used for the transaction (e.g., MasterCard, Visa, Amex, Other).
Data type: string
Sample values: NexPay, GlobalCard, SwiftCharge, TransactPlus
Domain knowledge: Card schemes determine network rules, interchange rates, and acceptance policies.
Field name: year
Description: Year when the payment was initiated.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 2023
Domain knowledge: Year is used for time-based reporting and trend analysis.
Field name: hour_of_day
Description: Hour of the day (0-23) when the payment was initiated.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 16, 23, 4, 3
Domain knowledge: Hour of payment can reveal peak transaction times and consumer behavior.
Field name: minute_of_hour
Description: Minute of the hour (0-59) when the payment was initiated.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 21, 58, 30, 5
Domain knowledge: Minute granularity can be useful for fraud detection and system monitoring.
Field name: day_of_year
Description: Day of the year (1-366) when the payment was initiated.
Data type: integer
Sample values: 12, 75, 96, 77
Domain knowledge: Day of year is used for aggregating transactions by month or season.
Field name: is_credit
Description: Boolean indicator if the transaction used a credit card (True) or not (False). Values are 'True' or 'False' as strings in the CSV.
Data type: string
Sample values: True, False
Domain knowledge: Credit transactions may incur higher fees and different risk profiles than debit., Fee rules may depend on whether the transaction is credit or debit.
Field name: eur_amount
Description: Transaction amount in euros.
Data type: float
Sample values: 151.74, 45.7, 14.11, 238.42
Possible formulas: monthly_volume = sum(eur_amount) over month by merchant
Domain knowledge: Transaction value is used for fee calculation, reporting, and risk assessment.
Field name: ip_country
Description: Country where the shopper was located at the time of transaction, determined by IP address.
Data type: string
Sample values: SE, NL, LU, IT, BE, FR, GR, ES
Domain knowledge: IP country can be used for fraud detection, compliance, and geo-based analytics.
Field name: issuing_country
Description: Country of the bank that issued the card used in the transaction.
Data type: string
Sample values: SE, NL, LU, IT, BE, FR, GR, ES
Possible formulas: intracountry = 1.0 if issuing_country == acquirer_country else 0.0
Domain knowledge: Issuing country is used to determine if a transaction is domestic or cross-border, impacting fees and risk.
Field name: device_type
Description: Type of device used by the shopper (e.g., Windows, Linux, MacOS, iOS, Android, Other).
Data type: string
Sample values: Windows, Linux, MacOS, iOS, Android, Other
Domain knowledge: Device type can indicate channel (mobile, desktop) and is useful for fraud analytics.
Field name: ip_address
Description: Hashed value of the shopper's IP address for privacy and tracking.
Data type: string
Sample values: pKPYzJqqwB8TdpY0jiAeQw, uzUknOkIqExYsWv4X14GUg, 3VO1v_RndDg6jzEiPjfvoQ
Domain knowledge: IP address is anonymized for privacy but can be used for session tracking and fraud detection.
Field name: email_address
Description: Hashed value of the shopper's email address for privacy and deduplication.
Data type: string
Sample values: 0AKXyaTjW7H4m1hOWmOKBQ, _Gm8at1k2ojYAM_wSEptNw, hzw3CbkxazpVg38re7jchQ
Domain knowledge: Email address is anonymized for privacy and can be used for identifying repeat customers or fraud.
Field name: card_number
Description: Hashed value of the card number for privacy and security.
Data type: string
Sample values: uRofX46FuLUrSOTz8AW5UQ, 6vqQ89zfCeFk6s4VOoWZFQ, EmxSN8-GXQw3RG_2v7xKxQ
Domain knowledge: Card number is hashed to protect sensitive data and prevent misuse.
Field name: shopper_interaction
Description: Type of shopper interaction: 'Ecommerce' (online) or 'POS' (in-person/in-store).
Data type: string
Sample values: Ecommerce, POS
Domain knowledge: Shopper interaction type affects risk, authentication requirements, and fee structure.
Field name: card_bin
Description: Bank Identification Number (BIN) of the card, used to identify issuing bank and card type.
Data type: string
Sample values: 4802, 4920, 4571, 4017
Domain knowledge: BIN is used for card scheme routing, fraud detection, and analytics.
Field name: has_fraudulent_dispute
Description: Boolean indicator if the transaction was disputed as fraudulent by the issuing bank. Values are 'True' or 'False' as strings in the CSV.
Data type: string
Sample values: True, False
Possible formulas: monthly_fraud_rate = sum(has_fraudulent_dispute == 'True') / count(*) over month by merchant
Domain knowledge: Fraudulent disputes impact merchant fees, risk scoring, and may trigger reviews.
Field name: is_refused_by_adyen
Description: Boolean indicator if the transaction was refused by Adyen (the payment processor). Values are 'True' or 'False' as strings in the CSV.
Data type: string
Sample values: True, False
Domain knowledge: Refusals may be due to risk, compliance, or technical issues and are important for monitoring approval rates.
Field name: aci
Description: Authorization Characteristics Indicator (ACI) code describing transaction authentication context.
Data type: string
Sample values: F, D, G, E, B, A
Domain knowledge: ACI codes indicate card presence, authentication method, and risk level., Correct ACI selection can optimize fees and reduce transaction friction.
Field name: acquirer_country
Description: Country where the acquiring bank (the merchant's bank) is located.
Data type: string
Sample values: NL, SE, IT, LU, BE, FR, GR, ES
Possible formulas: intracountry = 1.0 if issuing_country == acquirer_country else 0.0
Domain knowledge: Acquirer country is used to determine if a transaction is local or cross-border, impacting fees and compliance.
